description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange, effective from 05.10.2020 to 11.10.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It is a regulatory instrument that establishes the legal framework for calculating customs payments, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it names an official (the Director General of Customs), this is done in the context of exercising statutory powers to issue a regulatory notice, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed ministerial portfolios.
